title: Join Russell Loube and Abla Alami for a live chat on Mixpanel Experiments and Feature Flags
summary: Join Mixpanel’s live chat on November 19 to explore new features in Experiments, session replay integration, and ask your questions.
body_markdown:
Hey everyone,


👋


Back in April, Russell Loube told this community why Mixpanel built Experiments and Feature Flags. On


19 November at 3pm GMT


, he’s back, joined by Abla Alami, for a live fireside chat on what’s changed since. They’ll get into why isolated experimentation breaks down as teams move faster, how to connect session replay directly into the experiment process, and something Mixpanel unveiled at MXP Amsterdam that hasn’t been shown here yet. There’s a live Q&A, so bring a question if you’ve got one.


🔗


[Register here](https://events.mixpanel.com/same-mission-new-experiments/?utm_source=mixpanel-community&utm_medium=slack&utm_campaign=WBN-2026-11-19-EX-MoreShipsMoreProblems-EMEA-FM&utm_content=exp-webinar-slack-invites)
